script.title: The Little Canal Landing
script.description: Exactly 16 parts. A low navy launch approaches a tan arched footbridge. Sloped approaches connect the bridge to its stone banks; a staggered quay has two black mooring bollards. The boat remains separate, with a full stud of open water beside the quay and clearance beneath the arch. No water base.
